description:
- Lead architecture and delivery of a multi-factor digital identity platform serving millions of banking users; manage a cross-functional engineering team of 9.
- Designed and shipped a facial recognition and biometric onboarding system (MediaPipe, TensorFlow), achieving a 53% conversion rate at launch.
- Architected an event-driven serverless orchestration layer (EventBridge, SQS FIFO, Lambda, DynamoDB) for high-concurrency, multi-step authentication workflows.
- Built a real-time fraud-detection layer cutting review response time by 60%.
